premise.claim: Setting only imageTag in a component runtimeVersion is silently ignored: the AdvancedStatefulSet is not patched, pods keep the old image, no error/event/condition (issue #6178)
premise.reportedComponent: pkg/ddc/cache (CacheRuntime engine sync + transform paths, AdvancedStatefulSetManager.updateImage)
premise.evidence: On base, P0a/P0b fail with observed image fluid/cache:v1 (edit dropped) on both the update and create paths; the repo's own composition-matrix row pins the same behavior with knownBug #6178. Both pass on the PR head. results/base-harness.txt, results/pr-head-harness.txt
match: P0a [contract vs base]: update path applies an imageTag-only version
P0b [contract vs base]: create path applies an imageTag-only version
F1a [contract]: a digest image's missing tag stays incomplete
F1b [contract]: the update path never lands an invalid digest:tag reference
F1c [contract]: the create path never renders an invalid digest:tag reference
F2 [canary]: an empty-version worker follows the edited class template image
findings.changeReason: behavior documented as intended at 382d926a; promoted canary->contract as a regression guard

match: F3 [contract]: the shipped production config (--development=false) emits the discarded-edit signal in the log
F3 [contract]: a Warning event reports the discarded edit on the CacheRuntime
F3 [control]: a partial version the template completes emits neither signal
findings.changeReason: round 3: production code replaced logIncompleteVersion (V(1) log) with reportIncompleteVersion (V(0) log + RuntimeVersionIncomplete Warning event, incl. creation path); harness updated additively to the new symbol, contracts unchanged in substance

match: N2 [contract]: the discarded-edit log does not claim the image is left unchanged
N2 [contract]: the discarded-edit event does not claim the image is left unchanged
findings.changeReason: round 4: head 12d9b900 rewords the reportIncompleteVersion log/event from 'the image is left unchanged' to 'the version is ignored'; additive contracts pin the neutral wording so a future edit cannot reintroduce the creation-path-inaccurate claim

liveNote: L3 skipped this round (unit+integration scope). If run live: on a kind cluster, patch a healthy CacheRuntime's worker to runtimeVersion={imageTag:<new>}; expect the controller log 'image changed, will update' and the AdvancedStatefulSet image to move to <template-repo>:<new>. For F1, set runtimeVersion={image:<repo@sha256:...>} with no tag and observe the kubelet failing to parse the rendered reference.
